item.title: For years, right-wing media and right-leaning online shows have boosted a pro-MAGA social media account that Wired now says is secretly run by a Trump staffer
item.description: This week, Wired reported that a prominent pro-Trump social media account known as “Johnny MAGA” was being secretly run by a rapid response manager within the Trump administration named Garrett Wade. The account appeared to be just “another outraged supporter in the MAGA media ecosystem,” and for years, figures in that ecosystem have amplified and leaned on Johnny MAGA’s social media content to promote Trump and criticize Democrats and Trump opponents.
